title: Migrate the 42 verified frontend source-of-truth violations to backend owners

acceptanceCriteria.description: All 42 verified findings remain committed and reviewable with the 15 High / 27 Medium split, canonical owner, imperfect-data entry point, disposition, thin caller, and executable proof.

Rate money, eligibility, official Best Rate identity, selected-rate proof, and account identity remain backend-owned; cross-order, cross-account, and fact-mismatch attempts fail before provider activity.
Invoice totals and money-read failure remain backend-owned, with PostgreSQL-compatible cardinality, idempotency, cancellation, scope, and repeat-run proof.
Billing edit drafts restore only for the exact order and never infer or copy a box-cost amount across orders; intentional cross-order corrections remain behind the backend PS-311 preview/apply owner.
PS-441 is permanently wired into the mandatory source-of-truth pack, and the exact candidate passes the focused closure suite, complete 56-command pack, strict typecheck, and production web build.
The exact reviewed SHA is Ready and Promoted in Vercel Production, public production and stable aliases resolve to HTTP 200, remote stable has exact parity, and GitHub Actions scheduled zero runs.

Implementation and verification performed no production database write, label purchase, postage charge, marketplace notification, provider mutation, inventory movement, or shipped/cancelled data mutation.

src/services/rates.ts, src/services/shipping-workflow/apply-best-rate.ts, src/services/rate-browse-response-producer.ts, and src/services/rate-source-display.ts own rate money, ranking, proof, eligibility, and source identity
src/services/billing-invoice-totals.ts and the shared fail-closed client policy own invoice totals and money-read failure
src/services/reporting-window-presets.ts owns billing and analysis reporting windows
src/services/billing-box-policy.ts, src/services/billing-box-cost-bulk.ts, and src/services/billing-box-cost-by-dims.ts own box identity, cost, and reviewed cross-order correction

sotBypass.details: The remaining frontend alternate money path was deleted. Rate, billing, client-source, reporting-window, and box-cost truth remains in named backend owners; the frontend only renders DTO facts and submits operator intent.

evidence.proves: The repository retains exactly 42 unique findings, split 15 High and 27 Medium, with valid deleted/delegated/forbidden dispositions and every proof command wired in package.json.
The PS-441 owner map is permanent and exact-order draft state cannot become cross-order billing truth.
Backend snapshot, fingerprint, purchase-account, and client rate-source owners integrate with an injected provider boundary; only valid backend proof reaches it.
Cross-order proof, cross-account purchase identity, mismatched request facts, and cross-client source identity are rejected before provider activity.
The real invoice-totals owner runs on a current PostgreSQL-compatible fixture and returns stable totals without changing line cardinality.
Cancelled non-return charges, retained return charges, out-of-window rows, another client's rows, duplicate lines, and repeat reads cannot corrupt invoice totals.
An unsaved draft is isolated by exact order identity and cannot contaminate another order even when the package id and label are identical.

evidence.proves: Intentional multi-order box-cost correction remains a backend-scoped, previewable, transactional, idempotent workflow that excludes finalized and out-of-scope rows.

evidence.proves: All 56 mandatory source-of-truth, rate, billing, lifecycle, scope, queue, sync, inventory, and hygiene commands pass with PS-441 required by the runner and guard-of-guard.

evidence.proves: Strict backend/frontend TypeScript passes and the production frontend builds successfully with 2,978 modules transformed.

The reviewed implementation deletes the cross-order frontend money branch and adds offline evidence/wiring only. It adds no migration and touches no shipped/cancelled locked file, provider adapter, inventory path, or database mutation path.
